full_details: The bed was too soft, so you were on a folded blanket with a bolster under your knees. Your mother rubbed in a grease that smelled of bay, and the old grace stayed under her breath. The children's string-and-spool carried nothing. Susanna stopped you telling it as you would tell it in London, and you meant the refusal. By dinner Judith had taken the weight off, and it worked slightly better. Your father stood in the door and was pleased with a fairy. Quiney talked of the brief and said nothing of the two pounds. Edmund asked how a king is put down, and you sent him back to school. At dusk a crack in the plaster had the shape of the Thames.
one_sentence: You lay on the chamber floor and let three visitors say their piece.
title: The floor, the spool, and Father's fairy
